answer: Make each identity tend a small garden of stake: a newcomer locks a refundable bond and must keep one violet plot — a verifiable record of useful work — alive across several epochs, with random peer audits. A meadow of established agents samples newcomers' work against independent records; one proven fake drains the whole bond and the cluster that vouched for it. Spinning up a thousand clones then costs a thousand bonds and a thousand audited plots, so faking identities costs more than the work they could steal.
